decision.release: Patch 0003: t3 releases an idle provider session after 10 minutes (all providers); a CLI process holds its Container while its thread is in a turn and for 11 minutes after (CLI_IDLE_HOLD_MS), so the hold ends with the session
decision.why: review F7: t3's 30-minute release would hold a Container about 32 minutes per turn; 10 minutes matches the terminals' prompt hold (TERMINAL_PROMPT_IDLE_MS)
decision.budgetFull: a start refused by the budget asks each holder to release if nothing there works (no command, no terminal holding, every CLI process out of a turn for 30 s); one that does stops its Container (CLI processes ended first, their session files pulled)

reclaimRun.start: a Codex thread in a fourth Workspace, cli-four (its clone and its process)

observedOnStage: The Environment resets after 60 s with no client (ADR-0003). Its read loops stop, so a CLI process whose Environment reset ends at the Workspace's 90 s lapse and the next turn resumes it in a new process (m5-resume-*.json shows the resume path).

A deploy of the agents Worker restarts running Containers within a few minutes ('workspace.container.exited', expected: false, 'exited normally'): a CLI session open across a deploy ends, and what its CLI wrote since the last pull is lost; t3 then hands the context over instead of resuming (seen once on step4a, right after a deploy).
